# CityAtlas

CityAtlas is a Vancouver-first guide, route planner, and local discovery platform on a public crawlable domain.

## Summary

CityAtlas helps locals and visitors plan Vancouver more clearly with answer-first guides, neighborhood pages, source-backed starter routes, and visible correction paths. It also gives businesses a review-request path for clearer local visibility pages and guide placement. A narrower Toronto pilot now exists for first-time visitor destination choice using the same official-source and correction-path pattern.

## Current Status

CityAtlas is publicly crawlable at `city.univenturestudio.com`.
Public guide, mission, and source-backed route pages are open to crawling.
Protected operations and submission routes stay out of search.

## Best-Fit Users

- Vancouver locals looking for clearer city planning help.
- Visitors choosing neighborhoods, starter routes, and lower-friction plans.
- Local businesses exploring guide placement, route sponsorship, and stronger city-facing presentation.

- `/admin` - protected operations route

## Trust Notes

- Some marketplace-style business, event, and offer pages are sample formats and should not be treated as verified listings.
- Public source-backed pages link directly to official sources and visible correction paths.
- CityAtlas avoids fake rankings, unsupported availability claims, and scraped media.
- The main public query clusters are date night, rainy day, weekend route ideas, low-effort Sunday planning, wellness reset, work-friendly cafes, first-evening visitor loops, first-time visitor starting areas, returning-visitor local discovery, out-of-town guest hosting, itinerary starter routing, neighborhood-intent route planning, and a narrow Toronto first-visit pilot.
